questions.q: What is the programme mainly about?
options: The invention of the telephone
Why Stephen Fry finds phone calls embarrassing
How to make cheap long-distance calls
Why British people love technology
questions.why: They discuss Stephen Fry's view that talking on the phone is embarrassing and awkward.

questions.q: What is Stephen Fry known for, according to Sam?
options: Being very intelligent and knowledgeable
Inventing new phones and mobile apps
Hating all technology, even computers
Being a famous singer in the 1980s
questions.why: Sam says he's known for being extremely intelligent and very knowledgeable.

questions.q: Why is it surprising that Stephen Fry doesn't like the telephone?
options: He works for a phone company
He talks a lot on the radio
He loves technology
He lives abroad
questions.why: Neil says he's a technophile, 'but he's not a fan of the phone!'

questions.q: What point does the George Bernard Shaw quote make?
options: English people are very polite on the phone
English people talk far too much about the weather
English people love long phone calls with friends
English people judge each other harshly by speech
questions.why: As soon as one English person speaks, another despises them.

questions.q: What can people guess about you from your voice, according to Stephen Fry?
options: Your age, class and education
Your job and salary
Your height and weight
Your favourite hobbies
questions.why: He says age, class, education and vocabulary all come into play.

questions.q: Why does the fact that calls happen in real time make it worse?
options: Calls are too expensive to last very long
You have no time to think about what you say
The line is often bad and hard to hear
Other people nearby can listen to you talking
questions.why: Sam says they happen live, so you have no time to really think about it.

questions.q: Who does Stephen Fry especially hate talking to on the phone?
options: His family, especially his parents
Journalists who want an interview
Strangers, for example in shops
Other comedians he has worked with
questions.why: He says 'especially strangers in shops and things like that'.

options: Class is more important now than it was in the past
Stephen Fry is completely wrong about phone calls
She loves talking to strangers on the phone every day
We still judge people by how they speak, often wrongly
questions.why: She says we still make judgements based on how people speak, which can be completely false.
